title: How does the community handle regular check-ins or group updates among guests during Mahotsav?

segments.text: To ensure everyone stays informed and up to date throughout the Mahotsav: ​Live Announcements: Important information, schedule updates, and general announcements will be broadcast regularly using microphones and speakers across the venue. ​Dedicated Host: Parikshit Bhaiya will be guiding the event live, sharing key announcements and updates as they happen. ​Ashaeiynn App Access: All live updates, schedules, and notices will also be made available directly within the official app for your convenience.
